title: Looking ahead to BIOCORE
alt: Cardinal Dynamics students working together on the robot
summary: A new season means a new engineering challenge. BIOCORE kicks off January 9, 2027, with event details to follow.
paragraphs: BIOCORE is the FIRST Robotics Competition game for the 2026-2027 season. The game reveal and kickoff take place on January 9, 2027.
Our competition schedule will be shared once dates are confirmed. Check this page for season news and event updates.
Interested in joining the team or mentoring? Contact our coaches to learn about the robotics class and ways to get involved.
